description: Use this when the user plans work on a site (a deploy, an upgrade, a migration) and wants it marked as maintenance, once or on a schedule, optionally telling status page subscribers. Returns the window in the user's time zone (and the next occurrences of a recurring one), the status pages it shows on and how many subscribers would be emailed, with a draft id. Saves the draft and schedules nothing. Not for an outage that is already happening: use draft_incident_post.

day_of_month.description: For monthly on a date: the day, 1 to 31.

days.description: For weekly or biweekly: the weekdays, such as saturday. Default: the weekday of when's date.

description.description: Optional details shown with the window.

duration_minutes.description: How long it lasts, 1 to 720 minutes (12 hours).

notify_subscribers.description: Email the status page subscribers about it. Only when the user asks; default false.

recurrence.description: none (once, the default), daily, weekly, biweekly or monthly.

site.description: The site: its id, name or part of its URL.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone the time is in, such as Europe/London. Default: the user's own zone.

title.description: What the work is, as subscribers will read it.

week_of_month.description: For monthly on a weekday: which one.

weekday.description: For monthly on a weekday: the day.

when.description: When it starts: a date and time such as 2026-11-02 02:00 (read in timezone), or RFC 3339. For a recurring window, the time of day such as 02:00.

name: draft_maintenance
title: Draft a maintenance window
